control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during a breakdown response on V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on V-4110, LT-4110 and PSV-4111 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 8 May 2025 a regulatory notice was issued concerning V-4110, LT-4110 and PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following a breakdown response.
